'''Disasters and accidents'''

**A fire at a [[casino hotel]] in [[Poipet]], [[Cambodia]], near the [[Cambodia–Thailand border|Thai border]], kills at least 27 people and injures dozens of others. [https://apnews.com/article/thailand-cambodia-bangkok-government-95c9f9f591e4d7da8859ee461e3e9fce (AP)]

***[[Italy]] and the [[United States]] announce that they will require travelers from [[China]] to present a negative [[COVID-19 rapid antigen test]] in order to enter their countries. '''International relations'''
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Syrian peace process]]
***The [[defence minister]]s of [[Russia]], [[Syria]], and [[Turkey]] hold a trilateral meeting in [[Moscow]]. It is the first such meeting, as well as the first meeting between a Syrian and Turkish defence minister, since the war began in 2011. [https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20221228-russian-syrian-turkish-defence-ministers-meet-in-moscow-for-first-talks-since-2011 (AFP via France 24)]
*[[2022 North Kosovo crisis]]
**[[Kosovo]] closes two [[border crossing]]s with [[Serbia]] after protesters in Serbia block the border crossings in order to support the [[Kosovo Serbs|ethnic Serbs]] who are erecting [[barricade]]s in [[North Kosovo]] and who refuse to [[international recognition of Kosovo|recognize the independence of Kosovo]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/kosovo-closes-main-border-crossing-after-roadblock-serbia-2022-12-28 (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*Aftermath of the [[Grand-Bassam shootings]]
**A [[Judicial system of Ivory Coast|court]] in [[Abidjan]], [[Ivory Coast]], sentences four [[Mali]]an men to [[life imprisonment]] for [[Incitement|inciting]] an [[Islamist]] [[mass shooting]] that killed 19 people and injured 33 others at a beach resort in [[Grand-Bassam]] in 2016. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/international-news/20221228-i-coast-hands-down-four-life-terms-for-2016-jihadist-attack-1 (AFP via RFI)]
*[[Calabar Carnival]]
**Fourteen people are killed and 24 others are injured when a [[drunk driver]] drives into crowds at the annual [[carnival]] parade in [[Calabar]], [[Cross River State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-64102102 (BBC News)]
*[[Bolivia]]n police detain [[Creemos|opposition]] leader [[Luis Fernando Camacho]] for his role in the 2019 protests that prompted then-[[President of Bolivia|president]] [[Evo Morales]] to [[resign]].
